status.en: 27 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 69% more than the week before, most of them in Tigray, Amhara and Merti.
status.nb: 27 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 69 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Tigray, Amhara og Merti.

summary.en: Army drones have struck displaced persons camps in Amhara, killing civilians including children, while a separate drone strike in Tigray killed civilians collecting grain. The prime minister placed senior officials in military training at a centre in Hurso. Sudan has accused Ethiopia of supplying RSF with arms and of using Assosa airport as a launch base for RSF drones. Two attacks four days apart in Oromia killed 60 Orthodox Christians. The UCDP recorded 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Armens droner har angrepet forflytningsleirer i Amhara, og drept sivile inkludert barn, mens et separat droneangrep i Tigray drepte sivile som samlet korn. Statsministeren plasserte senior-offiserer i militær trening på et senter i Hurso. Sudan har anklaget Etiopia for å levere våpen til RSF-militsen og for å bruke Assosa flyplass som avfyringsbase for RSF-droner. To angrep fire dager fra hverandre i Oromia drepte 60 ortodokse kristne. UCDP registrerte 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
